boundary: This independently authored matrix is checked against DBCode's public package manifest only after the official package is installed locally. Exact vendor manifest content stays outside this repository, and the wrapper does not inspect, modify, repackage, or reverse engineer DBCode implementation code.

connection_capability_contract.supported_connection_scope: every item exposed by the exact installed DBCode New Connection catalogue

catalogue_snapshot.normalization: Unicode NFC, collapsed whitespace, case-sensitive code-point sort

connection_capability_contract.change_policy: Any changed extension version, public contribution digest, catalogue count, label digest, or section-shape digest creates a new candidate and requires complete release-pair review. A changed catalogue is never interpreted as an unsupported wrapper feature.

excluded_optional_runtime_members.reason: Python debugging is not used by DBCode notebook execution and the focused app does not expose a generic debugger.
The Open VSX package combination cannot start its expected pet binary, while DBCode Python cells work through the retained Jupyter and Python kernel path.

feature_groups.evidence: The rendered shell test opens Connections Home, fingerprints every counted item in DBCode's unchanged New Connection catalogue without storing its labels, and keeps the isolated Database Explorer, import, Tunnels, Authentication Profiles, a real sample database, and DBCode-owned object actions reachable without generic IDE navigation.

The rendered proof reviews JSON input, stages only approved non-secret fields as an owner-only CSV, invokes DBCode's unchanged importer, removes temporary data on cancellation and completion, and keeps a hyphen-path DuckDB connection out of the batch for an exact-version read-only preflight.
The rendered and licensed proofs execute project SQL through unchanged DBCode and retain only DBCode and basic editing context actions.

The rendered shell test opens only the DBCode History drawer and keeps its DBCode-owned actions available.

focused_routes: DBCode notebook toolbar and cell menus
feature_groups.evidence: The package retains the standard notebook host and renderer built-in. The DBCode 1.36.2 rendered proof opens a real DBCode notebook from the focused tools menu while the duplicate database-tree shortcut remains suppressed because its forwarded tree context was not a reliable host contract.

focused_routes: DBCode notebook cell language selector > Python
feature_groups.evidence: The complete Jupyter and Python runtime set is mandatory, pinned, verified, and installed into the private profile. The DBCode 1.36.2 rendered proof starts an isolated user-selected Python kernel, grants DBCode the normal first-use Jupyter permission, renders the deterministic output 42, and confirms that the permission is not requested again.

DBCode 1.36.2 still declares the custom editor. The prior pair did not register its provider, so the wrapper continues to hide the guaranteed-failure route during the update-pair gate. Direct CSV, Excel, Parquet, and Avro opening remains a separate documented compatibility gate; Connections is usable but is not claimed as feature-equivalent.

prior_compatibility_failure.message: The installed DBCode extension declares a data-file editor but did not register it with this Code OSS version. Use Connections to open data until a compatible DBCode or host update is available.

feature_groups.evidence: The DBCode 1.36.2 rendered proof opens the context-free Query Builder workflow and keeps the relationship-diagram action in Database Explorer without generic IDE actions. The duplicate Query Builder tree shortcuts remain suppressed because their forwarded tree context was not a reliable host contract.
The rendered shell test retains account actions, while the licensed quit-and-relaunch proof restores the user's lifetime entitlement through DBCode's own account surface.

focused_routes: DBCode tools > Set AI API Key
feature_groups.evidence: The DBCode 1.36.2 rendered proof opens DBCode's real provider and API-key workflows. Model selection remains available in DBCode's provider flow and filtered AI settings instead of a duplicate redirect. Generic Code OSS Chat remains intentionally absent; its language-model-tool integration is tracked separately from DBCode's native AI surfaces.

DBCode's provider auto-registers and its HTTP MCP settings remain available, but official documentation defines automatic registration and the HTTP server as separate capabilities. Manual HTTP Start, Stop, OAuth revoke, and one external client remain a separate focused compatibility gate and are not claimed as covered by automatic registration.
The wrapper opens the host settings editor with an exact DBCode extension filter, removes the editable settings search and generic category tree, and keeps the unrestricted settings shortcut blocked.

focused_routes: DBCode tools > Show Scratch Files in Finder
feature_groups.evidence: The focused menu resolves DBCode's configured local scratch path, creates it when needed, and asks the native host to reveal it in Finder. This avoids the prior DBCode external file-URL failure while leaving the extension unchanged. The filtered settings route exposes DBCode's path, rotation, and deletion controls.

command_exposure_policy.dbcode_owned_contexts: Commands declared on DBCode-owned contexts remain governed by DBCode's public when clauses, except for the duplicate tree shortcuts explicitly suppressed below. The wrapper adds only the focused routes listed above.
